title: Control Reinforcement Learning: Interpretable Token-Level Steering of LLMs via Sparse Autoencoder Features
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not use a benchmark that directly measures faith or religion. It observes that a Sparse Autoencoder (SAE) feature, interpreted and labeled as relating to 'faith and personal beliefs', incorrectly activates on financial terminology.
findings: The paper's only finding related to faith is an observation about an interpreted feature. A feature (L10/9145) labeled as 'expressions related to faith and personal beliefs' was found to activate on financial terms like 'Diamond' and 'Gold' in a math problem. This highlights that feature interpretations can be misleading and may activate based on abstract or surface-level similarities rather than true semantic meaning.
